verdict.rationale: Browser Use documents a separate open-source Python library, and its public GitHub repository is referenced, so users can read the core agent library's source. The pack never names the license, and the Cloud Agent/Browser products, including the hardened Chromium fork, are not described as open source. Missing for 10: the specific open license named in evidence, open-source status of the cloud components, and independent confirmation of the license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
